lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate part 10 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a young used-car flipper growing his capital. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «Гранта» is the Lada Granta car.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: woken up at 1 a.m., sleepy and annoyed. Line 2: firm, explaining the mistake in the rain. Line 3: calm, businesslike offer. Line 4: cool, slightly mocking, firm. Line 5: confident, cheerful.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: This time Zhora is defeated and asks for help. Line 1: on the phone at night, tired, humble, quiet. Line 2: desperate, loud. Line 3: bargaining, sharp, one word. Line 4: reluctant, grumbling, gives in. Line 5: shocked and overjoyed. Line 6: grateful, emotional, warm. «Студент» is his nickname for the young rival.

baba.profile: Babushka — a kind, chatty Russian grandmother in her 70s from a village house, warm, soft, a bit surprised.
baba.notes: One line: surprised and pleased at dawn, warm.
